mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing mutual metabolism inhibition and potentially elevating concentrations of active metabolites; fluphenazine may increase tamoxifen levels while tamoxifen may increase fluphenazine levels, with additive QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor for increased tamoxifen toxicity (thromboembolic events, endometrial effects) and fluphenazine adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, cardiac conduction abnormalities); baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended; consider alternative antipsychotic if possible.
